F08_descriptive_spearman.note: descriptive; section 8 reliability floor not assessed

V0_diagnostic.averaging_unit: publication group; mean over 5 discovery seeds

V1.comparator: B3 (identical to B4 by construction; checked)

unit_sensitivities_exploratory.reading: labelled sensitivities of the V1 averaging unit (the halves were balanced with the pooled remainder fold as ONE unit, section 3.2; the registered scoring unit is the publication group, section 4): scoring_filter 'remainder_fold_as_one_unit' (the remainder fold's rows form one unit) and 'remainder_fold_excluded_scoring' (its rows are not scored); both exploratory

V2.comparator_rule: stronger of B3x / B3i = lower selection-half focus-7 macro MAE (section 3.3 primary summary)

V5.A5: not computed pre-seal (section 9: the additive factorisation arm is fitted only after sealing)

lookup_comparator.rule: lower selection-half macro MAE of B3x and B3i (section 5), fixed here before any learned model is scored; a tie keeps B3x

V5.lookup_oracle_note: per-cell minimum over B3x, B3i, B3l, B4x (optimistic; selected on the scored rows)

V5_PAIR.DIR5_reading: pairs.pair_summary convention: each yardstick's unit-macro direction accuracy over the cell pairs where it is defined (HEAVIER: Ln(III)-Ln(III) pairs only; undefined pairs excluded and counted); DIR5 = the max of the three. Alternatives printed beside: HEAVIER undefined counted 1/2 on all pairs, and all three on Ln-Ln pairs only

V5_sensitivity_prediction_identity.note: row-level comparison with V5__primary on the same (fold_id, row_id); a sensitivity whose predictions are identical adds no independent evidence for that arm

not_run_pre_seal.V1_grouped10: not run (the exact design is registered for B0-B4, B7)
not_run_pre_seal.V5_batched: not run (exact leave-one-cell-out is registered for B0-B4, B7)

readings.B3x_B3i_anion_pool: B3x / B3i (and B4x): the nearest-radius and radius-bracket pool is the training metal states of the query's system measured with the query's acid anion; the anion is dropped (flag radius_pool_anion_dropped) only when no other metal state of the system has a training row with it (baselines.REGISTRATION_CHOICES['B3x_pool_anion'], fixed in code before any score)
readings.DIR5: pairs.pair_summary convention: each yardstick's unit-macro direction accuracy over the cell pairs where it is defined (HEAVIER: Ln(III)-Ln(III) pairs only; undefined pairs excluded and counted); DIR5 = the max of the three. Alternatives printed beside: HEAVIER undefined counted 1/2 on all pairs, and all three on Ln-Ln pairs only
readings.V0: diagnostic; unit = publication group (copy group), per discovery seed and the mean over the 5 seeds
readings.V0_inner_design: section 7 names no V0 inner design; the publication-grouped 3-fold (section 12 'publication-grouped calibration folds') with a level-V1 guard
readings.V1_unit_sensitivities: labelled sensitivities of the V1 averaging unit (the halves were balanced with the pooled remainder fold as ONE unit, section 3.2; the registered scoring unit is the publication group, section 4): scoring_filter 'remainder_fold_as_one_unit' (the remainder fold's rows form one unit) and 'remainder_fold_excluded_scoring' (its rows are not scored); both exploratory
readings.V1_units: unit = the row's group under the fold's grouping (group_cross_publication_copy for the registered design); half = the registered V1 half of the row's copy-group unit
readings.V2_comparator: stronger of B3x / B3i = lower selection-half focus-7 macro MAE (section 3.3 primary summary)
readings.V2_summaries: focus-7 lanthanides (primary), all 23 states, Ln(III) 14, actinide 9, each within a half
readings.V5_inner_guard: nested_certificate: one fold_isolation_check (level V5, component-aware, tol 0.005) per inner cell on the superset split (MODEL rows minus the cell's registered hiding, test = every row of the cell), shared across outer folds; the inner split is asserted nested in it. Every violation class of fold_isolation_check needs a training row and a test row, so removing rows from either side cannot create one. Cross-checked against every_split on sampled outer folds
readings.V5_units_clusters: unit = hidden cell; clusters = extractant_system_key and the publication group holding most of the cell's scored rows (ties: smallest label)
readings.acid_strata: acid_primary HNO3 / HCl / organic_acid (malonic, lactic, tartaric, citric) / other_mineral (H2SO4, HClO4)
readings.calibration_population: conformal calibration rows = the rows a fold would score: known metal state, not Sr(III), not V6_TARGET_ROWS, not an acidic co-extractant row; X(?) rows are never calibration rows (they are scored in no design)
readings.conformal_seed: inner calibration designs draw from seed 104729 (first discovery seed); V0 from its fold seed; the deterministic arms' interval widths therefore depend on this seed
readings.dga_stratum: system_family == diglycolamide vs every other family (the feasibility non-DGA definition)
readings.halves: every table is labelled with its half; difficulty numbers and descriptive contrasts use the selection half (section 9); confirmation-half values are printed, labelled, and inform nothing
readings.inner_units: every conformal inner design takes its inner units from the fold builder's functions and random streams (folds.source_holdout.inner_group_assignment for V1 and V0, folds.cell_holdout.inner_cell_majority + inner_cell_assignment for V5, folds.metal_holdout.inner_state_pick for V2)
readings.intervals: split-conformal intervals (ConformalWrapper) are computed for the registered calibration designs of section 12 (V5 primary, V1 copy exact, V2 element) and for V0; sensitivity variants, V5-P and V5-PAIR carry point predictions only (their registered use, R19 item 6, is the MAE Delta)
readings.scoring_exclusions: fold scored rows (known state, not Sr(III), not V6_TARGET_ROWS) minus the acidic co-extractant modifier rows (section 2: never scored as rows of a neutral cell), in every design
readings.sr_iii_dropped_training: the Sr(III) MODEL rows are removed from every outer training set (and from the inner calibration of nothing: point predictions only)
readings.support_score_domain_status: computed per design only when the registration is unambiguous on every scored row (s4: query-system inclusion and missing descriptors; UNSUPPORTED anion clause read 'system when present, else family' vs 'neither system nor family'); otherwise written as not computed with the ambiguous-row counts
readings.support_tau: tau_in / tau_ext / tau_max are recomputed per fold by gen19ct.evaluation.support.tau_thresholds and must equal the support_tau written by the fold builder beside the fold hash
readings.tau_percentiles: numpy.percentile linear interpolation of the leave-one-row-out condition_distance_pair over training rows whose (state, system) pair has >= 2 training rows; query dimensions missing in the row are skipped, training values imputed as in SupportIndex
readings.wildcard_copies: leakage sensitivity (verification finding VL-04), exploratory: scoring filters 'wildcard_copies_excluded_scoring' (a scored row with any leakage.wildcard_copy_pairs partner in its fold's training rows, folds/wildcard_copy_crossings.csv) and 'wildcard_copies_strict_excluded_scoring' (only strict_copy partners), for V5-primary and V1-copy

wildcard_copy_sensitivity_exploratory.reading: leakage sensitivity (verification finding VL-04), exploratory: scoring filters 'wildcard_copies_excluded_scoring' (a scored row with any leakage.wildcard_copy_pairs partner in its fold's training rows, folds/wildcard_copy_crossings.csv) and 'wildcard_copies_strict_excluded_scoring' (only strict_copy partners), for V5-primary and V1-copy
